description: Keys changed in a dataset since a feed position. Requires a valid key. Costs 0 credits. Every response's `meta.position` says how far into the change log its data goes, 404s included. To start, copy what you need and keep the smallest `meta.position` you saw as your `since`. To catch up, page through `/v1/changes?dataset=…&since=…` following `next_cursor`, fetch each added or changed key and delete each removed one, then set `since` to the smallest of the feed's `meta.to` and the `meta.position` of every response you just fetched, 404s included. A 404 on a fetch means that key isn't served yet; when the `company` feed later lists that company as added, fetch all its datasets. If a fetch fails with anything other than 200 or 404, or its `meta.position` is null, don't move `since`: fetch it again later. A 404 `since_unknown` or 409 `full_copy_required` means start again with a full copy. Changes are kept 90 days. If every response says `meta.position` is null, the change log isn't running yet: copy again in full once it is a number. This carries no figures. A figure can be withheld (null/absent beats a guess). A figure can change or disappear when a later filing arrives; figures are not versioned. Read `adjustments` for extractor decisions beyond copying one filed figure. This is filing data, not investment advice.
name: get_changes
title: What changed since
